text:
olivia chen: Vendor check-in: H100/H200 roadmap diverging on firmware cadence. Partner PM wants a single coordination doc for marketplace SKU gating and joint announcement playbook.
viktor orlov: Good call. We should avoid simultaneous marketplace tag flips + partner press. Propose 72h soft window between tag publish and external press.
hema rao: Agreed. Also SIs asked for a deterministic test harness image and a signed manifest. We'll deliver two channels: `h100-stable` and `h200-canary`.
chris l: Ops note: H100 thermal throttling incidents last quarter mean we need an automatic fallback routing policy to B200 or to lower-power H100 variants. Suggest threshold-based routing at 10% perf drop.
mike b: For marketplace, we need separate SKUs for dedicated vs marketplace-hosted so SIs can validate runtime behavior. I'll draft SKU names.
olivia chen: Draft timeline idea:
- T-14: share compatibility matrix + signed manifest process
- T-10: SI invites + staging ACLs open
- T-7: SI dryruns (NA/EU phased)
- T-3: marketplace SKU publish (internal embargo)
- T0: press announce window (48-72h notice to press)
- T+3: canary customers + monitoring escalation
hema rao: APAC needs extra firmware sign-off time (add +5 business days). EU legal will gate on T-4 for docs PRs. Tag `legal-eu` on PRs.
viktor orlov: Routing policy sample for rollout config (will open PR with exact variant names):
```
routing:
  primary: h100-v3
  fallbacks:
    - h200-compat
    - b200-lt
  perf_threshold_pct: 10
```
chris l: Ops can reserve a small canary pool: 60 H100 slots + 40 B200 slots for the first 72h. If we exceed 70% thermal events, auto-scale fallback to B200.
mike b: SKU proposals: `H100-v3-market`, `H100-v3-dedicated`, `H200-v1-market`, `H200-v1-dedicated`. I'll add mapping to the SKU sheet tonight: https://docs.internal/redwood/sku-registry (internal).
olivia chen: Partners asked for a one-page SI troubleshooting runbook (network, image verification, kernel logs, sample docker run). Can someone own a 1-pager?
hema rao: I can draft the runbook. Will include `sha256` checks, `dmesg` grep samples, and `kv-cache` tuning hints.
viktor orlov: Also add a small triage play for firmware regressions: steps to roll back SKU, revoke marketplace tag, and re-enable previous tag.
chris l: I'll set up monitoring alerts: thermal >5% over 15m, kernel oops rate, RPC latency >200ms. Dashboards at 1m/5m granularity for first 48h.
partners-bot: Calendar event created: "H100/H200 marketplace + SI dryrun" on 2026-06-08 10:00 UTC. Invitees: partnerships, eng-runtime, ops, legal-eu
mike b: Action items: @mike draft SKU mappings, @hema runbook 1-pager, @viktor PR for routing policy, @chris reserve canary pool and dashboards. Please update by EOD Tue.
olivia chen: If nobody objects by EOD tomorrow we'll ship this timeline to vendor PMs and SIs. :shipit: 
viktor orlov: +1
hema rao: +1
chris l: +1
partners-bot: Reminder scheduled: ping channel 4 days before T-14 start.
